# Parser test fixtures (KAN-64, KAN-70, KAN-75, KAN-76, KAN-85)

Trimmed samples of football.org.il responses, captured on **2026-10-11** (Israel time) for the parser tests KAN-67 will write. Only the part a parser needs is kept; scripts, styles, images, logos, navigation, ads and tracking were removed. See `../../docs/KAN-64-findings.md` for what each field means and its quirks.

Removed the print button (inline SVG) and inline `style` widths. Contains 6 played games with a result and 28 unscheduled games (`game_id=-1`, time `00:00`, no venue, no result). |

| `cloudflare-block-403.html` | The `403` page Cloudflare returned instead of the team-games page to `curl` and Node `fetch` | Reduced to the title and the two headlines a block detector needs. Removed the client IP address, the Ray ID (replaced with zeros), scripts and styles. |

**Game pages (`game-*.html`): the opponent is anonymised.** The product never stores, sends or shows the other club's players, so their real identities aren't committed either. The opponent side (the header side whose `team_id` isn't `7617`) exists in these files only so a parser can be tested on picking our side. On that side only, every opponent player's name is replaced by `שחקן יריב N` (N = 1, 2, … per page in order of first appearance, the same N in the lineup, the timeline and the "שערים:" line, where it replaces the surname-first entry), every opponent `player_id` by a fake `9000NN` (unique per page; real ids are far below it), with the link's form kept (`&season_id=28` on starters only), the opponent coach's name by `מאמן יריב` and its `coach_id` by `900100`. The masked name `*****` is kept as captured (its `player_id` is still faked). In the KAN-85 pages where neither side is Sderot (`game-1123493.html`, `game-1123518.html`), **both** sides are anonymised the same way: one numbering per page (home side first), the coaches `מאמן יריב` with `coach_id` `900100` (home) and `900101` (guest); names in the timeline and the shootout summary are matched by shirt number, in the "שערים:" line by their words. Everything else is real and unchanged: team names and ids, score, shirt numbers, roles, `(GK)` / `(C)`, every event and minute, and our side's names and ids (Sderot's own players, as decided for the KAN-70 fixture). A Cheerio dump of each file equals the dump of the live capture with this substitution applied.

Not captured: the league page itself (its standings, games and statistics sections are empty placeholders in the HTML) and the league's top-N statistics (`Components.asmx/LeagueStatistics`, not needed: KAN-70 found the full per-player season stats on the team page, `team-players-stats-7617-s28.xml`). Player cards were located in KAN-70 but not captured. Game details: the four `game-*.html` pages above (KAN-75); no game with an own goal, a penalty or extra time was captured. Cup lists (KAN-76): the two files above; no cup game with extra time, penalties, a `game_id` of `-1` or a future date existed to capture, and the Toto list was empty. KAN-85 added extra time and penalties (`natcup-2194-s28.xml`, `natcup-2338-s28.xml`); still no `-1`, no future cup game and no non-`null` `StandingTable` / `Comments`.
